purpose: Fresh-seed, same-source validation of the previously selected MambaTS v3 short-horizon PEMS candidate against modern forecasting baselines.
research_question: On four non-graph PEMS traffic-flow datasets at H12, is MambaTS v3 with the fixed AutoCon objective non-inferior to each same-snapshot baseline, and does AutoCon improve the same executable backbone over its lambda-zero control?
selection_history: MambaTS v3 and AutoCon_lambda=0.001 were selected only from older PEMS H12 exploratory screens. The fresh seeds below were not used in that selection.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only confirmation screen. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection. The scope is short-horizon non-graph traffic forecasting only; it makes no H96 or general time-series claim.
claim_boundary: A favorable result permits a separately authorized test-release design, not an immediate publication claim. AutoCon attribution requires the active versus exact lambda-zero comparison; Mamba backbone performance requires the plain and null controls.
prelaunch_gates: verify four PEMS hashes, feature axes, and train-only normalization contract
freeze the exact MambaTS v3 plain/null/active contract and all baseline runtime contracts
use fresh seeds only and pair every dataset-horizon-seed-model coordinate
run same-shape prediction and end-to-end resource benchmarks only after accuracy results are frozen

phases.name: pems_h12_modern_baselines
phases.purpose: Same-source linear, patch, periodic, inverted-variable, multi-scale MLP and plain Mamba references.

phases.name: pems_h12_mambatsv3_plain
phases.purpose: MambaTS v3 backbone without AutoCon representation objective.

phases.name: pems_h12_mambatsv3_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact AutoCon-capable MambaTS v3 executable graph with lambda zero.

phases.name: pems_h12_mambatsv3_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact AutoCon-capable MambaTS v3 graph with the preselected lambda 0.001 objective.

primary_contrasts: active versus exact lambda-zero AutoCon control
active versus every same-snapshot modern baseline
comparison_contract.noninferiority_margin: 0.01 relative validation MSE per dataset, assessed descriptively before any test release
comparison_contract.resource_contract: After the validation matrix is frozen, benchmark prediction-only latency, peak memory, parameters, and end-to-end training/validation wall time with identical device/software settings.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No result from this plan alone supports an all-horizon, graph-aware, general time-series, or test-set claim.

stopping_rules: Do not alter lambda, architecture, seeds, or budget based on these fresh-seed results.
If the active candidate is worse than the best baseline by more than 1% in any PEMS dataset mean, do not test-release it as a non-inferior short-horizon candidate.
If active does not improve the exact lambda-zero control consistently, retain the representation objective as an implemented ablation but do not claim causal AutoCon accuracy benefit.
Do not claim an efficiency advantage until the post-freeze resource contract is measured; DLinear and NLinear remain mandatory speed references.
